thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: New incident created — ingress-euc2-nic-saturation (P0)
pager: paging ashley for on-call
ashley: oncall here, what's the alert? saw a bunch of 502/504 pages.
evelyn: ALB and envoy metrics show a sudden surge of downstream 5xx and upstream connection resets starting ~07:54 UTC in euc2b. graphs: 5xx rate x10, envoy.upstream_cx_reset high.
dave: target-group health shows targets flapping in euc2b. node metrics show ENI retransmit and tx_drops elevated on nodes hosting ingress pods.
leo: pulling ALB access log sample:
```
2026-03-12T07:55:08Z request_id=xyz target_status=504 client_ip=5.6.7.8 backend_conn_close=true
```
ashley: backend_conn_close=true and high ENI errors — sounds like network saturation at host level. any recent infra jobs or noisy tenants?
dave: infra telemetry flagged a spike from tenant-99 in euc2b bulk exporting logs -> NAT gw saturated. infra alerted tenant and started emergency throttling.
maya: ingress team didn't deploy anything in the window. pod events show liveness/readiness failures at 07:53-07:56 causing kube to restart some ingress pods.

zane: envoy admin on one ingress pod:
```
envoy.upstream_cx_reset: 1120
envoy.upstream_cx_connect_fail: 12
envoy.cluster.ingress.upstream_rq_5xx: 320
envoy.listener.0.downstream_cx_close: 950
```
ashley: yep — upstream resets galore. we need quick mitigation to avoid wide customer impact.

proposal:
- shift Route53 weights away from euc2 to euc1 (failover) temporarily
- cordon/drain the most saturated nodes in euc2b to move pods
- scale ingress replicas in euc2 to reduce per-pod load
- infra to rate-limit tenant-99 and provision extra NAT capacity if needed

leo: applying Route53 weighted change now (TTL 30s). setting euc2 -> 20, euc1 -> 80.
dave: cordoning euc2b-node-12 and draining. `kubectl drain euc2b-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

evelyn: scaling ingress deployment in euc2 from 2 -> 6 replicas to increase redundancy: `kubectl scale deploy/ingress-controller -n ingress --replicas=6`

infra-bot: tenant-99 throttled at network edge. NAT gateway autoscale triggered for euc2 region.

maya: CS: customers reporting intermittent 5xx. initial impact estimate: ~18% of EU traffic saw elevated 5xx during window. drafting customer comms.

ashley: monitoring envoy metrics and ALB target health. any change yet?
evelyn: after drains + rate-limit, envoy upstream resets dropping. recent snapshot:
```
envoy.upstream_cx_reset: 96
envoy.cluster.ingress.upstream_rq_5xx: 26
```
leo: ALB target health stabilized; request volume to euc2 down ~70% post Route53 change.

dave: ENI retransmit counters decreasing on drained nodes. infra: will keep tenant throttled and investigate permanent limits.

ashley: good. declaring mitigation successful for now. next: handoff and post-incident tasks.

actions:
- collect logs from affected pods and nodes (07:30-08:10 window)
- gather ENI metrics, NAT gw metrics, and ALB access logs
- infra to review tenant onboarding/quota policy to prevent single-tenant NIC saturation
- consider adjusting ALB deregistration delay and target-health thresholds for faster failover
- evaluate automating Route53 weighted failover for AZ-wide network degradation

zane: saving commands used for forensics:
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:... > /tmp/tg-health.json
kubectl logs -n ingress ingress-controller-2 -c envoy --since=60m > /tmp/envoy-07-logs
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --metric-name NetworkPacketsOut --namespace AWS/EC2 --start-time 2026-03-12T07:30:00Z --end-time 2026-03-12T08:10:00Z > /tmp/eni-metrics.json
```

cs-team: customer note draft: short outage window 07:53-08:20 UTC, partial EU impact, mitigation applied (traffic shift + infra throttling). will update with final numbers.

ashley: handing off monitoring to follow-on oncall (zane) for 2 hours. evelyn will own data collection for postmortem.
evelyn: uploading artifacts to /incident/inc-1769812345 and starting trace replay to identify request classes most impacted.

incident-bot: incident annotated by ashley at 08:10 UTC — mitigation actions performed
pager: incident acknowledged by ashley

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) — ingress-euc2-nic-saturation -> downgraded to P1; monitoring in progress. duration ~00:37:55

ashley: quick retrospective: we failed over traffic fast, infra throttled noisy tenant, draining nodes helped. follow-up: stronger per-tenant egress caps, lower thresholds for ENI retransmit alerts, automate regional failover for ingress.
maya: i'll coordinate customer comms and postmortem write-up. moving this thread to postmortems after logs uploaded. :white_check_mark:
